label: Timeline Documentary
summary: Dated documentary sequences with archival frames, source labels, and an explicit concluding thesis.
description: Original Lucida chronology grammar for three to eight events, alternating evidence frames around a central dated spine and preserving missing-image states without fabricated replacements.
layoutGrammar: Keep one dated spine visible through the event field.
Place three to eight events in source order.
Attach a source label to every event.
Represent missing imagery with a deliberate placeholder and never infer a replacement.
Close with a thesis that distinguishes evidence from interpretation.

sourcePolicy.notes: No third-party media is embedded. Review frames use CSS-built archival abstractions and fixture-bound labels.

notes: Standalone family composition avoids edits to shared roots and registries.
Dense mode retains date and source labels while omitting event detail copy.
